694	        uint256 _positionId,
695	        CapitalRaiseAction _actionType
696	    )

699	    {

704	        if (position.investedCapital != position.cachedInvestAmount) {
705	            revert Errors.LegionSale__InvalidPositionAmount(msg.sender);
706	        }
707	
708	        // Construct the signed data
709	        bytes32 _data = keccak256(
710	            abi.encodePacked(
711	                msg.sender,
712	                address(this),
713	                block.chainid,
714	                uint256(position.cachedInvestAmount),
715	                uint256(position.cachedTokenAllocationRate),
716	                _actionType
717	            )
718	        ).toEthSignedMessageHash();
719	
720	        // Verify the signature
721	        if (_data.recover(_signature) != s_capitalRaiseConfig.legionSigner) {
722	            revert Errors.LegionSale__InvalidSignature(_signature);
723	        }
724	    }
